name: fast-explainer
description: Fast-cut, meme-and-cutaway-driven explainer style: dense visual changes, punchy short captions, aggressive-but-safe pause trimming, frequent keyword-triggered memes. Copy this file per channel/series instead of editing it in place.

captions.style_notes: Bold sans-serif, white text with dark outline or a soft drop shadow, bottom-center or lower-third. Occasional single accent word in yellow for emphasis, matching the reference style. Word-by-word pop-in highlight is a Tier 2 upgrade requiring a saved Fusion Text+ template — see references/resolve_scripting_api.md.
